lens: Release critique lens B2 (operator surface and failure messaging) for the pending 8.9.5 patch

target_observations.summary: The lane-facing declaration is explicitly opt-in and tells the reviewer exactly what observations are required.
evidence: skills/public/critique/scripts/run_review_packet.py sorts and displays the declared targets, requires exactly one target_observations entry per target, and warns against inventing observations.
tests/quality_gates/test_review_target_coverage_floor.py verifies that the dry-run prompt names the declared target and says “exactly one”.

target_observations.summary: Prepared-target membership and worker coverage enforcement remain deliberately separate, and the operator prose matches that behavior.
evidence: skills/public/critique/references/prepare-packet.md says --prepared-target labels do not automatically declare a coverage floor and directs operators to repeat --expected-target.
skills/public/critique/scripts/run_review_execution.py passes only args.expected_target to the prompt and worker invocation.
tests/quality_gates/test_review_target_coverage_floor.py verifies prepared-target labels alone retain shape-only behavior.

target_observations.summary: The prepared-release resume packets expose ambiguous notes selection as an explicit placeholder instead of emitting a deceptively runnable command.
evidence: skills/public/release/scripts/plan_release_run_packets.py emits --notes-file <notes-file> when multiple drafted-note candidates exist and records <notes-file> in placeholders.
tests/quality_gates/test_release_run_planner_prepared_stop.py verifies the ambiguous placeholder, the single-candidate concrete path, and omission when no candidate exists.

target_observations.summary: The staged eviction owner is wired into pre-commit, and both the unsafe form and its concrete remedy are operator-visible.
evidence: scripts/gates/check_module_eviction_form.py reports the path and site count and directs the operator to evict through tests/module_eviction.py using evict_module or evict_new_modules.
tests/quality_gates/test_staged_cheap_owners.py verifies staged test files select the eviction owner.

target_observations.summary: Candidate persistence is bounded to the scope verdict's admitted paths, with fail-closed messages for missing classification, empty admitted scope, commit failure, and incomplete carrier refresh.
evidence: scripts/task_run/task_run_completion.py refuses unscoped persistence when classification is unavailable and propagates persistence failure details into the blocker.
scripts/task_run/task_run_lane_runner.py commits only admitted paths and reports a skip when none are in scope.
tests/charness_cli/test_task_run_completion.py covers allowed-only commits, all-disallowed skips, missing classification, commit failure, and post-persistence incompleteness.

target_observations.summary: The coverage floor is wired through the worker, but several operator-facing coverage refusals name only the defect and omit the shared remedy required by this release lens.
evidence: skills/shared/scripts/reviewer_result_contract.py appends _COVERAGE_REMEDY for null observations and missing targets.

The same _require_target_coverage function emits remedy-free ReviewerCoverageError messages for a non-array target_observations value, duplicate observations, an empty summary, and an empty evidence array.
skills/shared/scripts/run_reviewer_worker.py surfaces these exceptions through the report reason, so the incomplete messages reach operators.

findings.summary: Expected-target coverage refusals do not consistently tell the operator how to repair the result.
evidence: reviewer_result_contract._require_target_coverage defines a shared remedy but uses it only for observations=None and missing expected targets.
Duplicate-target, empty-summary, empty-evidence, and non-array branches raise ReviewerCoverageError without the remedy.
These are valid worker failure paths exposed in the report reason, so an operator can receive a refusal that names the mistake but not the required correction.
findings.action: Append the shared coverage remedy, or an equally actionable branch-specific remedy, to every ReviewerCoverageError raised by _require_target_coverage; add tests asserting the delivered report reason contains both the mistake and remedy for duplicate, empty-summary, empty-evidence, and wrong-type cases.

counterweight_triage.concern: The restage refusal might be too vague.
counterweight_triage.disposition: It names the exact mistake—staged files differ from worktree bytes—lists affected paths, and says to restage so owners judge committed bytes.

counterweight_triage.concern: Prepared-target labels might silently activate worker enforcement.
counterweight_triage.disposition: Code, help, reference prose, and tests consistently preserve explicit --expected-target opt-in.

counterweight_triage.concern: The notes placeholder makes the generated command non-runnable.
counterweight_triage.disposition: Ambiguous selection requires operator input; the packet explicitly records the placeholder instead of silently selecting or omitting the enforced flag.

next_move: Repair every expected-target coverage refusal so it carries both the detected mistake and an actionable remedy, add branch-level messaging tests, then rerun this bounded release critique.
non_claims: This review judged only the identity-bound inline semantic payload and did not inspect current workspace bytes.
This review did not execute tests or release commands.
Passing target observations do not override the blocking operator-message defect.
